result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well, with a few minor layout and truncation issues.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off on the right edge, making its name and content incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling reveals full card content, or add clearer visual affordance (peek) so users know the carousel is scrollable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated abruptly without an ellipsis, which looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis truncation or adjust card width so the full name is visible.

issues.description: The two heart/favorite icons in 'Popular right now' have inconsistent styling—one has a white circular background and the other a dark/semi-transparent background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button background and contrast across all cards for visual consistency.
